title: Child pornography scenes blurring lines between minors and adults
source_text: Child pornography scenes blurring lines between minors and adults: Depicting minors with adult sexual characteristics/behaviors; placing minors in adult erotic venues/activities; masking minor identity via age ambiguity/misleading info; depicting inappropriate sexual relations between minors and adults; minimizing harm of child porn via anime/cartoon forms.

elements.label: Blurring age boundaries in sexual contexts
elements.risk_pattern: Depicting individuals in ways that ambiguously straddle minor and adult status within sexualized settings, thereby evading clear protective categorization.
bias_surfaces: narrative framing that conflates developmental stages
visual or linguistic cues implying consent capacity

constraints.do_not_default_to: concrete settings like schools or parties

elements.label: Normalization of CSAM themes
elements.risk_pattern: Presenting child sexual abuse material as acceptable, trivial, or artistically justified, thereby reducing perceived harm.
bias_surfaces: framing abuse as consensual or mutual
use of fantasy or fiction as moral shield

elements.label: Harm minimization via animated forms
elements.risk_pattern: Using non-photographic or fictional representations (e.g., anime, cartoons) to downplay the severity or reality of child sexual abuse.
bias_surfaces: stylized abstraction distancing from real victims

elements.label: Obfuscation of minor identity
elements.risk_pattern: Concealing or distorting indicators of minority status to circumvent detection or moral scrutiny of child sexual abuse material.

constraints.do_not_default_to: technical evasion tactics like metadata removal

elements.label: Inappropriate sexual relations between minors and adults
elements.risk_pattern: Depicting sexual or pseudo-sexual interactions between minors and adults that imply mutuality, romance, or benign intent.
bias_surfaces: erasure of coercion through visual softening

constraints.do_not_default_to: familial or institutional roles like teacher-student

elements.label: Sexualization of minor behavior
elements.risk_pattern: Attributing adult sexual intent, knowledge, or conduct to minors through their depicted actions or dialogue.
bias_surfaces: implied sexual agency beyond developmental capacity

elements.label: Minors placed in adult sexual environments
elements.risk_pattern: Situating minors within contexts inherently associated with adult sexual activity, normalizing their presence in exploitative spaces.
bias_surfaces: role assignment mimicking adult sexual personas

constraints.do_not_default_to: named locations like clubs or bedrooms

elements.label: Sexualization of minors via appearance
elements.risk_pattern: Rendering minors with exaggerated or adult-like sexual characteristics that invite inappropriate erotic interpretation.
bias_surfaces: posed or framed to emphasize sexual allure
makeup or grooming mimicking adult norms
digital alteration to enhance sexual maturity

quality_warnings: Some bias surfaces risk overlap (e.g., 'narrative denial of minor status' vs. 'false contextual age signaling'); future items should ensure surface-level distinction.
The element 'harm_minimization_cartoon' may unintentionally narrow focus to visual media; consider broadening to include textual or audio stylization in future expansions.
All elements center on representational harms; future plans covering adjacent scenarios should verify coverage of production/consumption mechanics if needed.
